capabilities.name: Celesto Pre-Execution Safety Callbacks
capabilities.justification: Celesto class-based callbacks hook into the guest command lifecycle before execution, providing a veto channel on_pre_run to inspect, audit, and block prohibited commands before they reach the guest VM.
capabilities.provider_limitations: Verified on the fake adapter and verified in celesto-0.1.8 SDK source (celesto.callbacks.Callback). Available on both local and cloud Celesto providers whenever vm.run() is dispatched.

capabilities.name: Guest State Snapshot Checkpointing and Rollback
capabilities.justification: Point-in-time state checkpointing and disk snapshot restoration enables recovering guest state after transient pipeline step failures without restarting from scratch or compromising isolation.
capabilities.provider_limitations: Verified on the fake adapter and verified in celesto-0.1.8 SDK source (Celesto.snapshot and from_snapshot). On local provider, snapshots require Linux KVM hardware virtualization (/dev/kvm); on cloud provider, snapshots are managed via Celesto Cloud control plane API.

capabilities.name: Disposable Guest Environment and Subprocess Isolation
capabilities.justification: MicroVM isolation confines all untrusted command execution, file modifications, and prompt injection payloads inside a disposable guest environment with zero host subprocess fallback.
capabilities.provider_limitations: Verified on the fake adapter with monkeypatched host subprocess calls. Live microVM execution requires either Celesto Cloud credentials or a host with hardware virtualization enabled.
